items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive releases and public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS completeness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Exact decision: continue read-only security evidence capture, keep private launch gates unchanged, and permit only reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, claims, and access boundaries. Do not retrieve credentials, change permissions, access private containers, exploit targets, deploy, add dependencies, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, build and deployment provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests or new production work.
